name: appmixer.ai.typesafe
label: TypeSafe AI
description: Integrate with TypeSafe AI and its Jev decision model. Instead of generating text, Jev answers typed questions about your content — classify into one of your options, score on your scale, or verify a statement — and returns the decision with calibrated probabilities and a confidence score in well under a second. English is the primary language; other languages work with lower accuracy.
